title_zh: 找到数学作业的失分步骤

scenario.label_zh: 根据数学作业反馈安排练习
scenario.goal_zh: 找出计算失误的位置并商定重做与检查的具体步骤

context_zh: 学生芬恩拿着批改后的数学作业向老师请教。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: My grade has gone up, but I still lost marks on the last two questions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Patel
sentences.text: There is a real improvement in how you set out your work. Let us look at where the calculation changes.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: I can hardly read the number I wrote on this line. Is that a three or an eight?

sentences.speaker: Ms Patel
sentences.text: You copied the three as an eight in the next step. The method itself is right.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: I am keen to stop making mistakes like that. Should I do twenty more questions?

sentences.speaker: Ms Patel
sentences.text: Start by doing these two again, with one step on each line. Then check each copied number against the question.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: I will redo them now and circle the numbers while I check.

sentences.speaker: Ms Patel
sentences.text: Good. Bring me the two new solutions when you finish, and we will compare them.
